text: 1. Age: FEDIAF Dog Late Growth puppies with an expected adult weight over 15 kg keep the calcium min of 2.5 g/Mcal and the Ca:P max of 1.6 after about 6 months of age, when FEDIAF allows 2.0 and 1.8 (notes n099 and n103).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A140 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 2. Breed: FEDIAF's preferred calcium max for Great Dane puppies (1.6% DM) is not applied (note n231).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A141 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 3. Added nutrients: FEDIAF's EU legal maxs for copper, iodine, iron, manganese, selenium and zinc apply only when the nutrient is added as an additive, and then to its total in the food, but are applied here to every diet (note n005).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A142 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 4. Sources: iron added as oxide or carbonate and copper added as oxide should not be counted toward the mins (notes n246 and n248); limits on added selenium and on phosphorus from soluble sources (cats) are not checked (notes n255 and n235).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A143 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 5. Conditional mins: the cat vitamin K and biotin mins apply to every diet, although the standards make them conditional (notes n272 and n280).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A144 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 6. Reference animals: NRC's per kg body weight^0.67 values for kittens and lactating queens apply to one reference animal; this checker uses them for every kitten or queen (notes n020 and n025).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A145 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 7. Moisture: foods with more than 12% moisture count as wet, a lower cut than FEDIAF's 14% (note n209); FEDIAF's wet-diet selenium values per kg BW^0.75 (dogs) or BW^0.67 (cats) are not used (note n257).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A146 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 8. Energy density: under an AAFCO requirement, a food below 4 kcal/g DM is compared with AAFCO's dry matter minimums and maximums only when its energy density is entered; without it, AAFCO's per Mcal values are used (note n299).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A147 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 9. Not calculated, only stated in notes: FEDIAF's increase of essential amino acids below 80% protein digestibility and the protein needs of bitches fed little carbohydrate (note n196), vitamin E for high PUFA or fish oil diets (note n268), vitamin B6 with protein in cats (note n276), trace minerals at high calcium (note n251), magnesium and urine pH in cats (note n244), and processing and storage losses (notes n170 and n274).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A148 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)

text: 10. This checker's own choices where the standards give no value: range highs derived from the min (notes n171 and n241), the carbohydrate default min (note n288), the energy density range (note n299), the energy estimates for the AAFCO requirements (note n029) and the folate DFE conversion (note n278).
source: Adapted from DDS template Version 21OCT26b, Standards tab A149 (docs/changes-from-21OCT26b.md)
